met_analysis:
The east-west trough from the cyclonic circulation associated with the above Low-Pressure Area over Southeast Bay of Bengal to northern parts of Maldives across Southwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining equatorial Indian Ocean and extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Eastcentral Arabian Sea & adjoining northern parts of Lakshadweep at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along long 74°E to the north of Lat 32°N.
A Fresh Western Disturbance is likely to affect Northwest India from 15th November, 2026.
